verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents LiveKit Agents' open-source, self-hostable nature (Apache-2.0 server, pip/npm installable framework) but contains no explicit mention of data export tooling, open data formats for conversation/session logs, or a documented exit/migration path for user data. Self-hosting mitigates lock-in in principle, but that is not the same as a documented 'export all data' capability.
